description: Connect an agent such as research-bot to Linear through an MCP endpoint
with a bearer token, not browser OAuth. GitHub repos use github_connect.
For a server that only signs people in through a browser (Notion,
``request_mcp_oauth`` instead; such servers reject a pasted key.
Match supported authentication; an API key is not automatically an MCP token.
Use ``attach_mcp_server`` for public servers without tokens. Never accept
credentials in chat. Connecting requires an admin.
This applies to new servers and replacements.
Posts a requester-only card naming the agent and the server, opening a private
form, expiring in 30 minutes. Submission attaches the server to the agent, not
this session's toolset. Check tool availability before promising use here.
Values never appear in chat; everyone talking to the agent can use the
connection. Pass the waiting task as `pending_task` so it resumes after the

channel_id.description: Compatibility field; origin controls the posting destination.

pending_task.description: The work that should run once the value is saved, in the person's words — a script, a file, a question. Omit it when they only asked to save or replace the key; the request itself is never a task.

server_name.description: Connection name; reuse at a new URL replaces it (admin if shared).

url.description: MCP endpoint URL accepting bearer authentication, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp.
